content:
mohit: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands Q&A on roadmap sequencing. Need explicit owners and contingency triggers for API, Console parity, and Optimize.

katie.ceo: Short summary: API GA target = 2024-07-15 (soft), Console parity v1 = 2024-08-05, Optimize beta = 2024-06-28. Owners: Alex (product), Nina (runtime), Tom (ops).

alex.prod: Product detail: API GA includes streaming, function-calls, and stable auth. If P99 latency or error rate spikes > 7% during canary, we hold.

nina.eng: Runtime note: batching/kv-cache changes are the main risk. Recommend canary window: staging 05/10, small-prod 05/17 (5% traffic), widen to 30% over 2 weeks if stable.

tom.ops: Ops constraints: need Dedicated capacity tagging in place before wide Console rollouts. Planning nodepool resize on 05/14-05/16. If tagging isn't ready, Console parity may slip a week.

mohit: Can we get a single timeline artifact for comms (incl. gates/owners) so support and sales can plan?

katie.ceo: Yes 30 I'll post a timeline doc with gates by Friday COB. It'll list owner contact info and the conditional triggers.

alex.prod: Also flag: Optimize beta will be opt-in for customers. We need to ensure control plane feature-flag exists by 05/09.

nina.eng: Confirming telemetry thresholds I'll add: P50/P95/P99 baselines + KV cache hit rate target. Will post numbers in the timeline doc.

doc-bot: New doc created: roadmap/gates-2024-07-08.md (link: https://internal.docs/roadmap/gates-2024-07-08)

tom.ops: Ops will run a dry capacity rehearsal on 05/13. I'll post the playbook and runbook link.

mohit: Any changes to public messaging?

katie.ceo: We'll call July 15th "target GA" but note it's conditional; commit to a firm announcement by 06/20 once canaries pass.

alex.prod: Action items: 1) Platform to confirm feature flag by 05/09 (owner: platform-eng). 2) DevEx to publish canary playbook by 05/07 (owner: devex). 3) Runtime to publish telemetry thresholds by 05/08 (owner: nina.eng).

nina.eng: I'll attach specific dashboards for P99 and cache-hit in the timeline doc.

tom.ops: If we see allocation churn during canary, we pause and escalate to infra lead.

mohit: Thanks 3 this helps. I'll coordinate the customer comms once the doc is live.

katie.ceo: I'll ping when the timeline doc lands. Marking this thread as summarized; further discussion will move to the timeline doc comments. :white_check_mark:
